시편 6:1.content: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

시편 6:2.content: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

시편 6:3.content: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

시편 6:4.content: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

시편 6:5.content: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

시편 6:6.content: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

시편 6:7.content: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

시편 6:8.content: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

시편 6:9.content: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.

시편 6:10.content: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
